A '''battle''' in the [[Lonnaw system/Legends|Lonnaw system]] took place in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], during the [[Orinda campaign]], between forces of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The holdings of various [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] had recently been unified to form the Remnant, and new [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] hoped to demonstrate the Remnant's power to the New Republic without provoking too aggressive of a response. Commanding from the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']] and assisted by [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]] and the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]], Pellaeon [[Raid on Orinda|captured]] Orinda and six [[Star system/Legends|systems]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|coreward]] along the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]]. Lonnaw was their final conquest. Pellaeon then sent emissaries to the New Republic and asked for the Remnant's new borders to be respected, but the New Republic instead responded with force.
